title: Pap and Eggs
steps: Boil 800 ml water with half the salt in one pot.
Pour in maize meal steadily while stirring to avoid lumps.
Lower heat, cover and stir every 5 minutes for 15 minutes until stiff.
Heat oil in pan, fry chopped onion and tomato for 4 minutes until soft.
Crack in eggs and scramble together until just set, season and serve with pap.

title: Oats and Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash bananas in a bowl until smooth.
Beat in eggs, milk and oats, add cinnamon and sugar and rest 5 minutes.
Heat a little oil in pan on medium heat.
Pour 2 tbsp batter per pancake and flatten slightly.
Fry 2 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Repeat with remaining batter and serve warm.

title: Peanut Butter and Jam Oats
steps: Boil milk or water in kettle or pot.
Add oats and pinch salt to pot and simmer 3 minutes, stirring.
Take off heat, stir in peanut butter until melted.
Spoon into bowls and top with jam.
Add a little extra milk if you like it looser.

title: Cinnamon Porridge
steps: Mix maize meal with 250 ml cold water to make a smooth slurry.
Boil remaining 250 ml milk and 300 ml water with salt in pot.
Stir slurry into boiling liquid, whisk to keep smooth.
Lower heat and cook 8 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in sugar, cinnamon and butter and serve hot.

title: Breakfast Mashed Potato Crumpets
steps: Peel and boil potatoes in salted water until very soft, then drain.
Mash potatoes smooth with no lumps, cool 5 minutes.
Beat in eggs, flour, half salt and pepper to form thick batter.
Heat oil in pan on medium heat.
Spoon 2 tbsp batter per crumpet and fry 3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper and serve hot with sauce or chutney.

title: Eggy Bun Bowls
steps: Butter bread slices on both sides and press into pan or oven-safe cups to form bowls.
Crack one egg into each bread bowl.
Sprinkle salt, pepper and grated cheddar on top.
Cook in hot pan covered with lid for 6 minutes or bake in oven at 180C for 10 minutes.
Serve immediately when egg white is set but yolk is still soft.

title: Scrambled Eggs in a Microwave
steps: Crack eggs into microwave-safe bowl and whisk with milk, salt and pepper.
Add butter pieces on top.
Microwave on high for 30 seconds, then stir.
Microwave another 30 seconds, stir again until just set.
Stop when slightly soft, it keeps cooking, and serve immediately.

title: Hashbrown and Egg Cups
steps: Grate potatoes coarsely and squeeze out water with clean cloth.
Mix grated potato with oil, half salt and pepper.
Press potato mix into 4 muffin cups or small oven-safe bowls.
Bake at 200C or fry in pan 10 minutes until golden and crisp.
Crack one egg into each cup, top with cheese and spring onion and cook 8 minutes until egg sets.

title: Tomato and Cheese Fold-Over Omelette Wrap
steps: Beat eggs with salt and chop tomato small.
Heat oil in pan on medium and pour in eggs.
Cook 1 minute then scatter tomato and cheese on one half.
Fold omelette in half and cook 1 minute until cheese melts.
Warm tortilla in same pan and wrap around omelette to serve.

title: Tomato and Onion Sandwiches
steps: Spread margarine thinly on all bread slices.
Slice tomatoes and onion very thin.
Layer tomato and onion on two slices, season well with salt and pepper.
Close with remaining bread slices and press down lightly.
Cut diagonally and serve immediately, or pack for lunch.

title: Two-Minute Noodle Upgrade
steps: Boil water in pot or kettle and cook noodles for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in pan, fry chopped onion and shredded cabbage for 3 minutes.
Push veg to side, crack in eggs and scramble quickly.
Toss noodles back in with seasoning sachet, mix well.
Serve hot straight from the pan.

title: Pilchards Burrito
steps: Heat oil in pan and fry chopped onion and grated carrot for 4 minutes.
Add pilchards with tomato sauce, break slightly and simmer 5 minutes.
Warm tortillas in dry pan for 20 seconds per side.
Spoon pilchards mix onto tortillas.
Top with shredded lettuce and fold tight to serve.

title: Kota (Quarter Loaf)
steps: Fry chips in hot oil until golden and crisp, drain and salt.
Fry eggs in same pan to your liking.
Hollow out bread slices slightly to make a pocket.
Layer chips, egg, cheese, atchar and chakalaka inside bread.
Close, press down and slice to share.

title: Steak Kota
steps: Season steak pieces with braai spice and salt.
Heat oil in pan and sear steak 6 minutes until browned and cooked.
Fry chips separately until crisp and golden.
Hollow bread to make a kota pocket.
Fill with chips, steak, atchar and grated cheese, close and serve hot.

title: Vegetarian Kota (Scambane)
steps: Fry chips until golden and set aside.
Heat oil in pot, fry onion until soft, add curry powder.
Add mixed veg with 100 ml water, cover and cook 8 minutes.
Hollow bread to make pocket.
Fill with chips, curried veg and chakalaka and serve.

title: Savory Mince on Toast
steps: Heat oil in pan and fry chopped onion for 2 minutes.
Add mince and curry powder, brown well breaking up lumps.
Add chopped tomatoes and salt, simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Toast bread slices in pan or toaster.
Spoon mince over toast and serve immediately.

title: BLT Egg Sliders
steps: Fry bacon in pan until crisp, drain and set aside.
Fry eggs in same pan sunny side or scrambled.
Toast bread slices lightly.
Spread mayo, layer lettuce, tomato, bacon and egg.
Close sliders and cut in half to serve.

title: Pap and Wors Bake
steps: Boil 800 ml water with salt, stir in maize meal and cook 15 minutes until stiff.
Fry wors in pan until cooked, slice into pieces.
Fry onion and tomato with oil to make relish.
Spread pap in oven dish, top with wors and relish.
Pour milk over, sprinkle cheese and bake at 180C for 15 minutes.

title: Pap with Chakalaka and Wors
steps: Cook maize meal in 1 litre salted water, stirring often until stiff pap forms.
Fry wors in hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Add onion and tomato to wors pan and fry 3 minutes.
Warm chakalaka in small pot or microwave.
Serve pap with wors on top and chakalaka on side.

title: Phutu Pap with Wors and Relish
steps: Bring 500 ml water and salt to boil, add maize meal and stir quickly to crumble.
Cover on low heat, stir with fork every 5 minutes for 20 minutes until fluffy phutu.
Fry wors until cooked, remove and slice.
Fry onion, add tomatoes and curry powder, simmer 8 minutes to make relish.
Serve phutu with sliced wors and spoonful of relish.

title: Umngqusho Wezambane (Samp with Potatoes)
steps: Soak samp and sugar beans overnight, drain and rinse.
Boil in 1.5 litres water with stock cube until tender, about 60 minutes.
Add cubed potatoes and chopped onion, cook 20 minutes until soft.
Stir with fork to thicken slightly, season with salt.
Drizzle oil and serve hot.

title: White Samp (Umngqusho Omhlophe)
steps: Rinse samp well and soak overnight if you have time.
Boil samp in 1.2 litres salted water on low heat.
Cook 70 minutes, stirring now and then until soft and creamy.
Drain excess water if any, add butter and stir through.
Season and serve hot as is.

title: Samp and Beans with Spinach and Bacon
steps: Soak samp overnight, then boil 60 minutes until almost soft.
Add drained sugar beans and cook 20 minutes more.
Fry bacon and chopped onion in oil until golden.
Stir in chopped spinach and wilt for 2 minutes.
Mix veg into samp and beans, season and serve.

title: Classic Chakalaka
steps: Heat oil in pot and fry chopped onion and green pepper for 3 minutes.
Add grated carrots, chopped tomatoes and curry powder, stir.
Cook 8 minutes until veg softens.
Add baked beans with sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot or cold.

title: Green Bean Bredie
steps: Heat oil in pot and brown mutton pieces well.
Add chopped onions and fry 3 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, stock cube and 500 ml water, cover and simmer 40 minutes.
Add trimmed green beans and cubed potatoes, cook 20 minutes until tender.
Season and serve with pap or rice.

title: Tomato Bredie and Dumplings
steps: Heat oil and brown lamb well on all sides.
Add chopped onion and fry until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes and 400 ml water, simmer covered 45 minutes.
Mix flour, beaten egg, pinch salt and 60 ml water to soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls of dough and potato cubes into bredie, cover 15 minutes until dumplings are cooked.

title: Vegetable Curry (SPAR)
steps: Heat oil in pot and fry onion and garlic 3 minutes.
Add curry powder and turmeric, stir 30 seconds.
Add mixed veg and chopped tomatoes with 200 ml water.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes until veg is tender.
Season with salt and serve with pap or rice.

title: Durban Vegetable Curry
steps: Heat oil and fry onion until golden.
Add garlic, curry powder, garam masala and cinnamon, stir.
Add tomatoes and 200 ml water, simmer 10 minutes to make gravy.
Add mixed veg, cover and cook 18 minutes until soft.
Season and serve with roti or rice.

title: Homemade Fish Cakes (Pilchard Frikkadels)
steps: Drain pilchards slightly and flake with fork.
Soak bread in little water then squeeze dry and crumb it.
Mix pilchards, crumbs, beaten egg, chopped onion and curry powder.
Form into 8 small cakes with hands.
Fry in hot oil 3 minutes per side until crisp and golden.

title: Gran's Famous Fish Cakes
steps: Boil potatoes until soft, drain and mash smooth.
Poach hake in little salted water 6 minutes, flake and remove bones.
Mix mash, fish, chopped onion, chilli and coriander.
Add beaten egg and crumbed bread to bind, season well.
Shape into 8 cakes and fry in hot oil until golden both sides.

title: Pan-Fried Vetkoek and Curried Mince
steps: Mix flour, baking powder and salt, add milk to form soft dough.
Divide into 8 balls and flatten slightly.
Heat 4 tbsp oil in pan and fry vetkoek 4 minutes per side until puffed.
In another pot, fry onion and grated carrot, add mince and curry powder.
Brown mince well, add 100 ml water and simmer 10 minutes, serve with vetkoek.

title: Sweet Potato and Mince Bake Topped with Egg
steps: Peel and cube sweet potatoes, boil until soft then mash roughly.
Heat oil and fry onion until soft, add mince and curry powder and brown.
Add chopped tomatoes and salt, simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Spread mince in oven dish, top with sweet potato mash.
Beat eggs and pour over, bake at 180C for 15 minutes until egg sets.

title: Hot Spicy Mince with Magwinya
steps: Mix flour and half salt with 250 ml warm water to soft dough, rest 20 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil, fry onion and garlic, add mince, chilli and curry powder.
Brown mince and simmer 10 minutes with 100 ml water.
Divide dough into 8 balls and flatten.
Fry magwinya in remaining hot oil 4 minutes per side until golden and serve with mince.

title: Ouma Onder die Kombers
steps: Boil whole cabbage leaves 3 minutes until soft, drain.
Soak bread in water, squeeze and mix with mince, onion, egg, salt and pepper.
Place spoonful mince in each leaf and roll tightly.
Pack rolls seam down in pot, add tomato sauce and 300 ml water.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes until cabbage tender and mince cooked.

title: Sardine Pasta
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente, drain and keep 100 ml water.
Heat oil, fry garlic and chilli 30 seconds.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook 4 minutes.
Add sardines with sauce, break lightly and toss through pasta.
Loosen with pasta water and serve hot.

title: Peri-Peri Sardine Alfredo Pasta
steps: Boil penne in salted water until soft, drain.
Heat oil and fry garlic 30 seconds.
Add sardines and peri-peri sauce, stir gently.
Pour in cream and simmer 3 minutes until slightly thick.
Toss pasta through sauce, sprinkle cheese and serve.

title: Pilchard Stew
steps: Heat oil in pot and fry chopped onion and grated carrot 3 minutes.
Add curry powder and chopped tomatoes, cook 5 minutes.
Add pilchards with sauce, do not break too much.
Simmer 8 minutes until thick and saucy.
Season and serve with pap or rice.

title: Smoky Pilchard Stew with Steamed Spinach Dombolo
steps: Heat oil and fry onion until soft, add tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes.
Add pilchards with sauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt and chopped spinach with 120 ml water to dough.
Form small balls for dombolo.
Place dombolo on top of stew, cover and steam 15 minutes until cooked through.

title: Boontjiesop (Bean Soup)
steps: Brown beef pieces in pot with little oil.
Add chopped onion, carrots and tomatoes and fry 3 minutes.
Add 1.2 litres water, stock cube and beans with liquid.
Bring to boil then simmer 70 minutes until beans soft and meaty.
Season and serve hot with bread.

title: Samp and Beans
steps: Soak samp and sugar beans overnight, rinse well.
Boil in 1.5 litres water with stock cube for 60 minutes.
Add chopped onion and cook 20 minutes until soft and creamy.
Add oil and stir through, season with salt.
Serve hot as is or with stew.

title: Cape Malay Lentil Curry
steps: Rinse lentils and rice separately.
Heat oil and fry onion and garlic until soft.
Add curry powder and garam masala, stir 30 seconds.
Add chopped tomatoes, lentils and 600 ml water, simmer 20 minutes.
Cook rice in separate pot and serve curry over rice.

title: Lentil Potato Curry
steps: Heat oil and fry onion and garlic 3 minutes.
Add curry powder and stir.
Add cubed potatoes, lentils, tomatoes and 600 ml water.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes until potatoes and lentils are soft.
Season and serve with pap or rice.

title: Sugar Bean Stew with Pap
steps: Fry onion in oil until soft.
Add curry powder and chopped tomatoes, cook 5 minutes.
Add sugar beans with sauce, 200 ml water and stock cube, simmer 15 minutes.
Cook maize meal in 800 ml salted water until stiff pap forms.
Serve pap with bean stew on top.

title: Baked Bean Shepherd's Pie
steps: Boil potatoes until soft, drain and mash with pinch salt.
Heat oil and fry onion until soft, add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Add baked beans and simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Spread bean mix in oven dish, top with mash and rough up with fork.
Sprinkle cheese and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until golden.

title: Curry Bean Stew
steps: Heat oil and fry onion and grated carrot 3 minutes.
Add curry powder and chopped tomatoes, stir.
Add both tins beans with sauce and 150 ml water.
Simmer 15 minutes until thick and fragrant.
Season and serve with pap or rice.

title: Monk Soup
steps: Heat oil and fry onion and garlic until soft.
Add shredded cabbage and grated carrots, fry 3 minutes.
Add lentils, stock cube and 1.2 litres water.
Bring to boil then simmer 25 minutes until lentils soft.
Season and serve hot with bread.

title: Split Pea Soup
steps: Rinse soup mix and lentils.
Place in pot with 1.2 litres water, stock cube and chopped onion.
Bring to boil and simmer 30 minutes.
Add cubed potatoes and carrots and cook 20 minutes until soft.
Season and mash lightly for thicker soup.

title: Every-Grain Vegetable Stew
steps: Boil samp in water 30 minutes until starting to soften.
Heat oil and fry onion and garlic.
Add cubed butternut, brown rice, tomatoes and tomato paste.
Add 600 ml water and simmer 25 minutes until grains and butternut tender.
Season and serve as is.

title: Comforting Veggie Stew
steps: Heat oil and fry onion until soft.
Add curry powder, tomatoes and mixed veg, stir 2 minutes.
Add lentils, rice and 800 ml water.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes until rice and lentils cooked.
Season and serve hot.

title: Pumpkin, Beans and Potato Stew
steps: Heat oil and fry onion and garlic 3 minutes.
Add cubed pumpkin and potatoes, fry 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, beans with sauce, stock cube and 400 ml water.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes until veg tender.
Season and serve with pap.

title: Potato and Chickpea Curry
steps: Heat oil and fry onion and garlic until soft.
Add curry powder and stir 30 seconds.
Add cubed potatoes, chickpeas with liquid, chopped tomatoes and 300 ml water.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes until potatoes tender.
Season and serve with rice or pap.

title: No Fuss Four Bean Soup
steps: Heat oil and fry onion and green pepper 3 minutes.
Add curry powder and chopped tomatoes, cook 4 minutes.
Add both tins beans with sauce and 500 ml water with stock cube.
Bring to boil then simmer 15 minutes.
Season and serve hot with bread.

title: Mac and Cheese
steps: Boil macaroni in salted water until soft, drain.
Melt butter and margarine in pot, stir in flour to make paste.
Pour in milk slowly whisking until thick white sauce.
Stir in half cheese, salt and pepper until melted.
Mix sauce through macaroni, top with remaining cheese and grill 5 minutes until golden.

title: Creamy Tuna Pasta Bake
steps: Boil penne until soft, drain.
Melt butter, stir in flour, then milk to make white sauce.
Add half cheese and mixed herbs, stir until smooth.
Mix pasta, drained tuna and sweetcorn through sauce.
Pour into dish, top with remaining cheese and bake at 180C for 15 minutes.

title: Mince and Macaroni Bake
steps: Boil macaroni until soft, drain.
Fry onion, add mince and brown well.
Add chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, herbs, stock cube and 200 ml water, simmer 12 minutes.
Mix macaroni through mince sauce.
Pour into dish, top with cheese and bake at 180C for 15 minutes.

title: Cheesy Mixed-Veg Pasta Bake
steps: Boil penne with mixed veg in salted water until soft, drain.
Heat milk with cream cheese and garlic until smooth.
Stir in half cheddar and mixed herbs.
Mix pasta and veg through cheese sauce.
Top with remaining cheese and bake or grill 10 minutes until golden.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until tender, drain.
Fry onion and grated carrots 3 minutes.
Add mince and brown well breaking lumps.
Add tomato paste, tomato sauce, herbs, stock cube and 300 ml water, simmer 20 minutes.
Serve sauce over spaghetti.

title: Chicken and Veg Stir Fry
steps: Cook rice in salted water until fluffy.
Heat oil in pan very hot, fry sliced chicken 5 minutes until golden.
Add garlic, ginger and frozen veg, stir-fry 4 minutes.
Splash soy sauce and 50 ml water, toss until glossy.
Serve stir fry over rice.

title: Beef and Cabbage Stir Fry
steps: Cook rice until soft and fluffy.
Heat oil hot and fry onion and mince until browned.
Add shredded cabbage and grated carrots, stir-fry 5 minutes until just tender.
Add soy sauce and toss.
Serve over rice with extra soy if needed.

title: Bacon and Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook rice ahead and cool slightly, or use leftover rice.
Fry bacon in hot pan until crisp, remove and chop.
Fry grated carrot, peas and white of spring onion 2 minutes.
Push to side, scramble eggs in pan.
Toss everything with rice and soy sauce, top with green spring onion.

title: Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
steps: Boil egg noodles until soft, drain and set aside.
Heat cooking oil and sesame oil, fry sliced chicken thighs 6 minutes until golden.
Add garlic, shredded cabbage and grated carrots, stir-fry 4 minutes.
Toss in noodles and soy sauce, mix well until glossy.
Serve hot straight from pan.

title: Russian Sausage and Cabbage Noodles
steps: Boil egg noodles until tender, drain.
Slice russians and fry in oil until browned.
Add chopped onion and shredded cabbage, fry 5 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, paprika and 50 ml water, simmer 3 minutes.
Toss noodles through and serve.

title: Chicken Mayo Wrap
steps: Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper and fry in oil 8 minutes until cooked.
Slice chicken thinly.
Warm tortillas in dry pan.
Spread mayo, add lettuce, cucumber and chicken.
Roll tight and cut in half to serve.

title: Polony and Cheese Wrap
steps: Warm tortillas briefly in pan.
Spread mayo and tomato sauce.
Layer sliced polony, grated cheese and lettuce.
Roll up tight.
Slice and pack or serve immediately.

title: Bean and Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Fry onion in oil until soft, add cumin and chilli.
Add drained sugar beans and mash lightly, cook 3 minutes.
Spread bean mix on half of each tortilla, top with cheese.
Fold and fry in dry pan 2 minutes per side until cheese melts.
Serve with salsa.

title: Chickpea and Coconut Curry
steps: Cook rice until fluffy and set aside.
Heat oil, fry onion, garlic and ginger 3 minutes.
Add curry powder and chopped tomatoes, cook 4 minutes.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk, simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Serve over rice.

title: Red Lentil Dhal
steps: Rinse lentils well.
Fry onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add curry powder, turmeric and tomatoes, stir.
Add lentils and 800 ml water, simmer 25 minutes until soft and thick.
Cook rice separately and serve dhal with rice.

title: Chicken and Potato Curry
steps: Fry onion, garlic and ginger until soft.
Add curry powder and chicken thighs, brown 5 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, cubed potatoes and 400 ml water.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes until chicken cooked and potatoes soft.
Cook rice and serve curry over rice.

title: Pilchard Curry
steps: Cook rice until fluffy.
Boil potatoes until half soft, drain.
Fry onion in oil, add curry powder and tomatoes.
Add potatoes and pilchards with sauce, simmer 10 minutes.
Serve curry over rice.

title: Beef and Four Bean Soup
steps: Brown beef pieces in oil.
Add chopped onion and carrots, fry 3 minutes.
Add 1.2 litres water, stock cube, cubed potatoes and beans.
Bring to boil then simmer 40 minutes until beef tender.
Season and serve hot with bread.

title: Chicken and Sweetcorn Soup
steps: Boil chicken thighs in 1.2 litres water with stock cube 20 minutes, remove and shred.
Add grated carrots, chopped onion and macaroni to broth and cook 10 minutes.
Add sweetcorn with cream sauce and shredded chicken back in.
Simmer 8 minutes until thick and creamy.
Season and serve hot with bread.

title: Creamy Butternut Soup
steps: Heat oil and fry chopped onion until soft.
Add cubed butternut and flour, stir 1 minute.
Add 800 ml water and stock cube, simmer 25 minutes until soft.
Mash or blend until smooth, stir in milk and season.
Toast bread and serve soup with toast.

title: Cottage Pie
steps: Boil potatoes until soft, drain and mash with margarine and milk.
Fry onion and grated carrots, add mince and brown well.
Add tomato paste, stock cube and 200 ml water, simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in peas, spread mince in oven dish.
Top with mash and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until golden.

title: Soya Mince Cottage Pie
steps: Soak soya mince in 300 ml hot water with stock cube for 10 minutes.
Boil potatoes and mash with margarine and pinch salt.
Fry onion, add mixed veg and soaked soya mince with liquid.
Add tomato paste and simmer 12 minutes until thick.
Spread mix in dish, top with mash and bake 15 minutes at 180C.

title: Chicken and Veg Tray Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 200C.
Cut potatoes, butternut, carrots and onions into chunks.
Toss veg with oil and half spice in large tray.
Place chicken thighs on top, rub with remaining spice and oil.
Bake 40 minutes until chicken cooked and veg golden.

title: Sausage and Sweet Potato Tray Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 200C.
Cut sweet potatoes, potatoes and onions into chunks.
Toss veg with oil, paprika and salt in tray.
Add sausages on top.
Bake 35 minutes turning once until sausages cooked and veg soft.

title: Hake and Spinach Bake
steps: Thaw and squeeze spinach dry.
Mix spinach with cream cheese, garlic and half milk.
Place hake fillets in oven dish, season with salt.
Pour spinach mix over fish.
Top with grated cheddar and bake at 180C for 25 minutes.

title: Tuna and Four Bean Salad
steps: Drain tuna and four bean mix.
Chop cucumber, tomatoes and onion small.
Mix everything in large bowl.
Whisk vinegar, oil and pinch salt for dressing.
Pour over salad and toss to serve.

title: Chicken Mayo Meal Salad
steps: Slice or shred cooked chicken breasts.
Chop lettuce, cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix chicken with mayo in bowl.
Arrange salad veg on plates and top with chicken mayo.
Serve with bread slices on side.

title: Tuna and Corn Fritters
steps: Drain tuna and sweetcorn.
Mix tuna, sweetcorn, chopped spring onions, eggs and flour with salt.
Heat oil in pan on medium.
Spoon 2 tbsp mix per fritter and fry 3 minutes per side.
Drain and serve hot.

title: Cheese and Veg Omelette
steps: Chop onion, green pepper and mushrooms small.
Melt butter and fry veg 3 minutes until soft.
Beat eggs with pinch salt.
Pour eggs over veg, stir gently then let set.
Sprinkle cheese, fold and cook until cheese melts.

title: Bacon and Potato Frittata
steps: Boil potatoes until soft, slice.
Fry bacon and onion in oil until golden.
Add potatoes and peas and fry 2 minutes.
Beat eggs and pour over mix, sprinkle cheese.
Cook on low 10 minutes covered, then grill 5 minutes until set.

title: Toasted Cheese and Tomato
steps: Spread margarine on outside of bread slices.
Grate cheese and slice tomato thin.
Sandwich cheese and tomato inside bread, margarine outside.
Fry in hot pan 2 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cut and serve immediately.

title: Pancakes with Cinnamon Sugar
steps: Mix flour and salt in bowl.
Beat eggs and milk together and whisk into flour until smooth.
Heat little oil in pan and pour thin layer batter.
Fry 1 minute per side until golden.
Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over hot pancakes, roll up.

title: Bacon, Egg and Tomato Toast
steps: Fry bacon in pan until crisp, set aside.
Fry eggs in same pan to your liking.
Toast bread and spread with margarine.
Top toast with bacon, egg and sliced tomato.
Season and serve hot.

title: Tennis Biscuit Fridge Tart
steps: Crush half biscuits and mix with melted butter, press into dish as base.
Whisk instant pudding with 300 ml cold milk until thick.
Whip cream and fold into pudding.
Spread cream mix over biscuit base.
Top with remaining biscuits whole and chill 20 minutes.

title: Fish Fingers, Chips and Peas
steps: Bake or fry chips until golden and crisp.
Fry or bake fish fingers 10 minutes until cooked.
Boil peas 3 minutes and drain.
Serve fish fingers with chips and peas.
Squeeze lemon and add tomato sauce on side.

title: French Toast with Cinnamon Sugar
steps: Beat eggs with milk in shallow bowl.
Mix sugar and cinnamon in small bowl.
Dip bread slices in egg mix both sides.
Heat butter and oil and fry bread 2 minutes per side until golden.
Sprinkle cinnamon sugar over hot toast and serve.

title: Banana French Toast
steps: Mash bananas smooth and mix with beaten eggs, milk and cinnamon.
Dip bread slices into banana egg mix.
Melt butter in pan on medium heat.
Fry bread 2 minutes per side until golden and set.
Serve hot as is, no syrup needed.

title: Egg and Cheese Scramble Cups
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease muffin tray with oil.
Fry onion, green pepper and mushrooms 4 minutes until soft.
Beat eggs with salt and mix in veg and half cheese.
Pour into 8 muffin cups.
Top with remaining cheese and bake 12 minutes until set.

title: Bacon and Egg Scramble Cups
steps: Chop onion finely.
Heat oil in pan on hot plate on medium heat.
Fry bacon and onion for 4 minutes until bacon starts to crisp.
Beat eggs with salt and pepper in a cup.
Pour eggs into pan and scramble gently for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over eggs and let melt for 1 minute.
Spoon scramble into mugs or cups and serve hot.

title: Overnight Oats with Banana and Peanut Butter
steps: Combine oats, milk and yoghurt in a bowl or jar.
Stir in peanut butter and honey until smooth.
Cover bowl and place in fridge overnight.
Slice banana just before eating.
Stir oats, top with banana slices.
Add extra honey if you want it sweeter.

title: Instant Maize Porridge with Peanut Butter and Banana
steps: Boil water in kettle.
Pour milk into pot and heat on hot plate until hot but not boiling.
Whisk in instant maize porridge and stir for 1 minute until smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter until melted.
Slice banana on top and serve immediately.

title: Maltabella Porridge with Milk and Sugar
steps: Mix maltabella with 100 ml cold milk to make a smooth paste.
Heat remaining milk in pot on hot plate until just starting to boil.
Whisk paste into hot milk and stir continuously.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes stirring often.
Remove from heat and stir in margarine and sugar.
Serve hot with extra milk if you like.

title: Rolled Oats with Honey and Sultanas
steps: Pour milk into pot and bring to gentle boil on hot plate.
Add oats and reduce heat to low.
Cook for 5 minutes stirring often until thick.
Stir in sultanas and cook 1 minute more.
Spoon into bowls and drizzle honey on top.
Let cool slightly before eating.

title: Banana Peanut Butter Smoothie Bowl
steps: Peel and mash bananas in a bowl with a fork until smooth.
Add peanut butter, yoghurt and milk and whisk until thick.
Stir in honey.
Spoon mixture into two bowls.
Sprinkle oats on top for crunch.
Serve immediately.

title: Amasi Breakfast Bowl with Oats and Honey
steps: Toast oats in dry pan on hot plate for 2 minutes until lightly golden.
Chop apple into small cubes.
Pour amasi into two bowls.
Top with toasted oats and apple cubes.
Drizzle honey over each bowl.
Serve immediately.

title: Yoghurt Bowl with Apple and Cinnamon
steps: Chop apple into small cubes, keep skin on.
Spoon yoghurt into two bowls.
Top with apple cubes.
Sprinkle cinnamon evenly over yoghurt.
Drizzle honey on top.
Mix lightly and eat.

title: Breakfast Wrap with Egg and Cheese
steps: Chop onion and tomato finely.
Heat oil in pan on hot plate on medium heat.
Fry onion for 2 minutes until soft.
Beat eggs and pour into pan, scramble with onion for 2 minutes.
Warm tortillas in dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Spoon egg onto tortillas, add tomato and grated cheese.
Fold wrap and serve hot.

title: Egg and Tomato Tortilla Wrap
steps: Chop tomatoes and onion.
Heat oil in pan on medium heat.
Fry onion for 2 minutes until soft.
Add tomato and cook for 2 minutes until softened.
Beat eggs and pour over tomato mix.
Scramble until eggs are just set.
Spoon onto warm tortillas, roll up and serve.

title: Avocado Toast with Fried Egg
steps: Toast bread in pan or toaster until golden.
Heat oil in pan on hot plate and fry eggs sunny side up for 3 minutes.
Mash avocado in bowl with squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper.
Spread avocado on toast.
Top each slice with a fried egg.
Sprinkle extra pepper and serve immediately.

title: Cinnamon Sugar Toast
steps: Toast bread until golden in pan or toaster.
Mix cinnamon and sugar in small cup.
Spread margarine on hot toast.
Sprinkle cinnamon sugar evenly over toast.
Cut into triangles and serve warm.

title: Peanut Butter and Banana Toast
steps: Toast bread until golden.
Spread peanut butter on hot toast.
Slice banana into thin rounds.
Arrange banana slices on top of peanut butter.
Drizzle honey over banana.
Serve immediately.

title: Baked Beans on Toast
steps: Toast bread in pan or toaster.
Pour baked beans into pot and heat on hot plate for 3 minutes.
Spread margarine on toast.
Spoon hot beans over toast.
Sprinkle pepper and serve hot.

title: Baked Beans with Sausage on Toast
steps: Toast bread until golden.
Pour beans with sausage into pot and heat for 4 minutes on hot plate.
Spread margarine on toast while hot.
Spoon beans and sausage over toast.
Serve immediately with fork.

title: Scrambled Eggs with Tomato and Onion
steps: Chop onion and tomatoes finely.
Heat oil in pan on hot plate on medium heat.
Fry onion for 2 minutes until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook 2 minutes.
Beat eggs with salt and pepper and pour into pan.
Stir gently until eggs are just set and serve hot.

title: Fried Egg and Polony Sandwich
steps: Heat oil in pan on hot plate.
Fry polony slices for 1 minute per side.
Push polony to side and fry eggs for 3 minutes.
Spread margarine on bread slices.
Place polony and egg on bread and add tomato sauce.
Close sandwich and serve warm.

title: Rooibos and Toast with Yeast Spread
steps: Boil water in kettle.
Place rooibos bags in mugs and pour boiling water.
Brew for 3 minutes, add sugar if you like.
Toast bread until golden.
Spread margarine then thin layer of yeast spread.
Serve toast with hot rooibos.

title: Buttermilk Flapjacks with Cinnamon Sugar
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar and cinnamon in bowl.
Beat eggs, buttermilk and 1 tbsp oil together.
Pour wet mix into dry mix and whisk until smooth batter forms.
Heat a little oil in pan on medium heat.
Fry 2 tbsp batter per flapjack for 2 minutes per side.
Mix remaining sugar with extra cinnamon and sprinkle over hot flapjacks.

title: Corn Fritters
steps: Pour sweetcorn into bowl including a little juice.
Add eggs, flour, baking powder, salt and pepper and mix to thick batter.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in pan on medium heat.
Spoon 2 tbsp batter per fritter into pan.
Fry for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper and serve warm.

title: Pilchards on Toast
steps: Chop onion finely.
Heat oil in pan on hot plate on medium.
Fry onion for 3 minutes until soft.
Add pilchards with tomato sauce and break into chunks.
Heat through for 3 minutes.
Toast bread until golden.
Spoon pilchards over toast and serve hot.

title: Milk Tart
steps: Crush tennis biscuits and mix with melted butter.
Press biscuit mix into dish to make crust and chill in fridge.
Heat 400 ml milk in pot until almost boiling.
Whisk remaining 100 ml milk, condensed milk, eggs, corn flour and vanilla in bowl.
Pour egg mix into hot milk and whisk on low heat until thick.
Pour filling onto biscuit base.
Sprinkle cinnamon on top and chill until set.

title: Malva Pudding
steps: Preheat oven to 180C.
Beat 150 g sugar, eggs and jam in bowl until light.
Melt 50 g butter and mix with milk and vinegar.
Sift flour and bicarb, fold into egg mix alternating with milk mix.
Pour into greased oven dish.
Bake for 30 minutes until golden.
Heat cream, remaining butter and remaining sugar in pot for sauce.
Pour hot sauce over hot pudding and serve.

title: Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease loaf pan with butter.
Mash bananas in bowl with fork.
Beat butter and sugar until soft then add eggs.
Add mashed bananas and mix.
Sift flour, baking powder, bicarb and cinnamon into bowl.
Fold dry ingredients into wet until just combined.
Pour into pan and bake for 45 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Lemon Fridge Tart
steps: Crush tennis biscuits into fine crumbs.
Melt butter and mix with crumbs, press into dish for base.
Whisk condensed milk and fresh cream until thick.
Grate lemon zest and squeeze juice.
Add lemon juice and zest to cream mix and whisk.
Pour lemon filling over biscuit base.
Chill in fridge for 2 hours until set.

title: Caramel Condensed Milk Tart
steps: Crush tennis biscuits and mix with melted butter.
Press into dish to make crust and chill.
Boil unopened condensed milk tin in pot of water for 90 minutes, cool completely.
Open tin and whisk caramel until smooth.
Spread caramel over biscuit base.
Whip fresh cream until thick.
Spread cream over caramel and chill for 1 hour.

title: Jelly and Custard Build
steps: Make jelly with boiling water from kettle according to packet and pour into bowls.
Chill until set.
Heat 400 ml milk in pot on hot plate.
Mix custard powder, sugar and remaining 100 ml cold milk in cup.
Pour custard mix into hot milk and whisk until thick.
Pour warm custard over set jelly.
Serve warm or chilled.

title: Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Mix flour, cocoa, sugar and baking powder in bowl.
Add milk, oil and vanilla and whisk until smooth batter.
Divide batter between 2 mugs.
Microwave each mug for 1 minute 30 seconds until risen.
Let cool 1 minute before eating.
Serve straight from mug.

title: Baked Apples with Cinnamon and Sultanas
steps: Preheat oven to 180C.
Core apples and place in oven dish.
Mix sugar, cinnamon and sultanas in bowl.
Fill centre of each apple with sultana mix.
Dot butter on top of each apple.
Add splash of water to dish and bake 25 minutes until soft.

title: Baked Banana with Honey and Cinnamon
steps: Preheat oven to 180C.
Peel bananas and place in oven dish.
Dot butter over bananas.
Drizzle honey and sprinkle cinnamon.
Bake for 12 minutes until soft and golden.
Serve warm straight from dish.

title: Cinnamon Sugar Puff Pastry Twists
steps: Preheat oven to 200C and line tray with baking paper if you have.
Leave pastry on counter for 10 minutes to defrost slightly.
Melt butter and brush over pastry sheet.
Mix sugar and cinnamon in cup and sprinkle over buttered pastry.
Cut pastry into 2 cm strips with knife.
Twist each strip and place on tray.
Bake for 12 minutes until puffed and golden, then cool slightly and serve.

title: Instant Pudding with Tennis Biscuit Crumble
steps: Crush tennis biscuits into coarse crumbs with hands.
Melt butter in pan on hot plate and toast crumbs for 2 minutes until golden.
Pour cold milk into bowl and whisk in instant pudding for 2 minutes until thick.
Spoon pudding into 4 cups or bowls.
Sprinkle buttery biscuit crumble on top of each.
Chill for 5 minutes and serve.

title: Chocolate Biscuit Pudding
steps: Whisk condensed milk and cocoa in bowl until smooth.
Whip fresh cream in separate bowl until thick, then fold into cocoa mix.
Place a layer of tennis biscuits in dish.
Spread half the chocolate cream over biscuits.
Add another layer of biscuits and remaining cream.
Smooth top and chill in fridge for 1 hour until set.
Slice and serve cold.

title: Rice Pudding with Cinnamon
steps: Rinse rice and place in pot with 500 ml milk on hot plate.
Bring to gentle boil then reduce to low heat.
Cook for 25 minutes stirring often until rice is soft.
Add remaining milk, sugar and sultanas and cook 10 minutes more until creamy.
Spoon into bowls.
Sprinkle cinnamon on top.
Serve warm.

title: Bread Pudding
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease oven dish with butter.
Tear bread into cubes and place in dish with sultanas.
Whisk eggs, milk, 3 tbsp sugar and cinnamon in bowl.
Pour custard over bread and press down, let soak 10 minutes.
Dot remaining butter on top and sprinkle remaining sugar.
Bake for 30 minutes until golden and set.
Serve warm with extra milk if you like.

title: Jelly Fruit Salad
steps: Make jelly with boiling water from kettle according to packet, use 100 ml less water for firmer set.
Pour jelly into bowl and let cool 10 minutes.
Chop apple, peel and slice banana, orange and naartjies into small pieces.
Add all fruit to slightly cooled jelly and mix.
Chill in fridge until set.
Spoon into bowls and serve cold.

title: Custard Slice
steps: Preheat oven to 200C.
Cut pastry into two equal sheets and bake each for 15 minutes until golden, then cool.
Heat 400 ml milk and sugar in pot until almost boiling.
Mix custard powder with remaining 100 ml cold milk in cup.
Pour custard mix into hot milk and whisk on low heat until very thick.
Place one pastry sheet in dish, spread thick custard over it.
Top with second pastry sheet and sift icing sugar over, slice and serve.

title: Coconut Ice
steps: Sift icing sugar into large bowl.
Add desiccated coconut and mix.
Pour in condensed milk and mix with spoon until sticky dough forms.
Press mixture into greased dish or tray.
Chill in fridge for 1 hour until firm.
Cut into squares and serve.

title: No-Bake Cheesecake
steps: Crush tennis biscuits into fine crumbs.
Melt butter and mix with crumbs, press into dish to make base and chill.
Beat cream cheese until smooth in bowl.
Add condensed milk and whisk until thick.
Squeeze lemons and add juice to mix, whisk until set.
Pour filling over biscuit base and smooth top.
Chill for 2 hours until firm and slice.

title: Chocolate Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease small oven pan.
Melt butter in pot on low heat, remove from heat.
Stir in sugar and cocoa until smooth.
Add eggs one by one and beat well.
Sift flour and baking powder and fold into chocolate mix.
Pour into pan and bake for 20 minutes until just set.
Cool slightly then cut into squares and serve.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and line baking tray with baking paper if you have.
Beat butter and sugar until light and creamy.
Add eggs one by one and beat well.
Sift flour and baking powder and fold into butter mix.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Spoon tablespoon balls onto tray, leaving space between.
Bake for 12 minutes until golden at edges, cool slightly and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease baking tray.
Beat peanut butter and sugar together until smooth.
Add egg and mix well.
Sift in flour and mix to form soft dough.
Roll into walnut-size balls and place on tray.
Press each ball with fork to flatten.
Bake for 12 minutes until lightly golden and cool.

title: Oat Crunchies
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease baking tray.
Melt butter in pot on low heat.
Mix oats, flour, sugar and bicarb in bowl.
Pour melted butter into dry mix and stir to combine.
Press mixture into tray evenly.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden.
Cut into squares while warm and let cool in tray.

title: Buttermilk Rusks
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease oven dish.
Melt butter in pot on low heat, remove and add buttermilk.
Mix flour, sugar and salt in large bowl.
Pour buttermilk mix into dry mix and stir to soft dough.
Spread dough into dish and bake for 45 minutes until cooked.
Break into chunks and place on tray.
Dry in oven at 100C for 30 minutes until hard and crunchy.

title: Coconut Biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease baking tray.
Beat butter and sugar until creamy.
Add egg and beat well.
Sift in flour and add coconut, mix to soft dough.
Roll into small balls and place on tray.
Flatten slightly with fork.
Bake for 12 minutes until light golden and cool.

title: Jam Tarts
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease muffin tray or tart tray.
Rub butter into flour and sugar until like breadcrumbs.
Add beaten egg and mix to form dough.
Roll dough on floured surface and cut into circles.
Press circles into tart holes.
Spoon teaspoon jam into each tart.
Bake for 15 minutes until pastry is golden.

title: Buttermilk Scones
steps: Preheat oven to 200C and flour baking tray.
Sift flour and baking powder into bowl, add sugar.
Rub butter into flour until crumbly.
Pour in buttermilk and mix quickly to soft dough, do not overmix.
Pat dough 2 cm thick on floured surface and cut into rounds.
Place on tray and bake for 12 minutes until risen and golden.
Cool slightly and serve with butter and jam if you have.

title: Apple Crumble
steps: Preheat oven to 180C.
Peel and chop apples into small cubes and place in oven dish.
Sprinkle 2 tbsp sugar and cinnamon over apples.
Rub butter into flour and remaining sugar until crumbly.
Stir in oats to make topping.
Sprinkle crumble topping evenly over apples.
Bake for 30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

title: Banana Custard
steps: Heat 300 ml milk in pot on hot plate until almost boiling.
Mix custard powder, sugar and remaining 100 ml cold milk in cup until smooth.
Pour custard mix into hot milk and whisk on low heat until thick.
Slice bananas into rounds.
Spoon custard into bowls and top with banana slices.
Serve warm.

title: Instant Pudding Trifle
steps: Make jelly with boiling water from kettle according to packet and let cool until slightly set.
Whisk instant pudding with cold milk for 2 minutes until thick.
Crush tennis biscuits into rough pieces.
Layer biscuits, jelly, then pudding in glasses or large bowl.
Whip fresh cream until thick and spoon on top.
Chill for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Pumpkin Fritters with Cinnamon Sugar
steps: Peel pumpkin, chop into cubes and boil in pot until soft, then drain.
Mash pumpkin until smooth with fork.
Mix in 2 tbsp sugar, flour and beaten eggs to form thick batter.
Heat oil in pan on hot plate on medium heat.
Spoon 2 tbsp batter per fritter and fry 2 minutes per side until golden.
Mix remaining sugar and cinnamon in bowl.
Toss hot fritters in cinnamon sugar and serve warm.

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease oven dish.
Peel sweet potatoes, chop and boil until soft then drain and mash.
Stir melted butter, sugar, cinnamon and milk into mash.
Beat in eggs until smooth.
Pour into greased dish.
Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden on top.
Serve warm.

title: Butternut Pudding
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease oven dish.
Peel butternut, chop and boil until very soft then drain and mash smooth.
Stir in melted butter, sugar and cinnamon.
Add eggs and beat well.
Fold in flour until just combined.
Pour into dish and bake 30 minutes until firm.
Serve warm with extra sugar if you like.

title: Ice Cream with Chocolate Sauce
steps: Scoop ice cream into 4 bowls and keep in freezer.
Place cocoa, sugar and milk in pot on low heat.
Stir until sugar dissolves.
Add butter and stir until glossy sauce forms.
Remove from heat and let cool 1 minute.
Pour warm chocolate sauce over ice cream and serve immediately.

title: Drinking Chocolate Pudding
steps: Heat 400 ml milk in pot on hot plate until almost boiling.
Mix drinking chocolate, custard powder, sugar and remaining 100 ml cold milk in cup.
Pour chocolate mix into hot milk and whisk continuously.
Cook on low heat for 3 minutes until thick like pudding.
Remove from heat.
Spoon into bowls and serve warm.

title: Condensed Milk Lemon Pudding
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and grease oven dish.
Separate eggs.
Whisk condensed milk, egg yolks, lemon juice, zest and flour until smooth.
Beat egg whites with sugar until stiff peaks.
Fold egg whites into lemon mix gently.
Pour into dish and place dish in larger pan with hot water from kettle.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden on top and serve warm.

title: Peppermint Crisp Tart
steps: Crush half the tennis biscuits and layer in bottom of dish.
Whip fresh cream until thick in bowl.
Fold in condensed milk.
Grate peppermint crisp chocolate.
Layer half the cream mix over biscuits and sprinkle half the grated chocolate.
Add remaining biscuits as second layer, then remaining cream.
Top with remaining grated chocolate and chill 1 hour.

title: Sweet Cinnamon Popcorn
steps: Heat butter in pot on hot plate until melted, add popcorn kernels.
Cover pot and shake until popping slows down.
Remove from heat when popping stops.
Mix sugar and cinnamon in cup.
Sprinkle cinnamon sugar over hot popcorn while tossing.
Serve warm in bowls.

title: Tuna Mayo Toastie
steps: Drain tuna and sweetcorn.
Mix tuna, sweetcorn and mayonnaise in bowl.
Place bread slices on board and spoon tuna mix onto 2 slices.
Grate cheese and sprinkle over tuna.
Close with remaining bread slices.
Toast in dry pan on hot plate 3 minutes per side until cheese melts and bread is golden.

title: Ham and Cheese Toastie
steps: Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place 2 slices butter side down on board.
Top with ham and grated cheese.
Close with remaining bread, butter side up.
Heat pan on hot plate on medium and place toasties in pan.
Fry 3 minutes per side until cheese melts and bread is golden, then serve hot.

title: Polony and Cheese Toastie
steps: Spread margarine on one side of each bread slice.
Place 2 slices margarine side down on board.
Top with sliced polony and grated cheese.
Close with remaining bread, margarine side up.
Heat pan on hot plate on medium heat.
Fry toasties 3 minutes per side until cheese melts and bread is golden.

title: Sardine Toastie
steps: Chop onion finely.
Drain sardines slightly and flake into bowl, keep some tomato sauce.
Mix onion into sardines.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place 2 slices butter side down, spoon sardine mix on top.
Close with remaining bread butter side up.
Toast in dry pan 3 minutes per side until golden and heated through.

title: Spiced Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Preheat oven to 200C and line tray with baking paper if you have.
Drain chickpeas and rinse, pat dry with clean cloth.
Toss chickpeas with oil, curry powder and salt in bowl.
Spread in single layer on tray.
Roast for 20 minutes shaking tray halfway until crunchy.
Cool slightly before eating.

title: Roasted Tinned Lentils
steps: Preheat oven to 200C and line tray.
Drain lentils and rinse well, pat very dry.
Toss lentils with oil, curry powder and salt.
Spread thinly on tray.
Roast for 18 minutes until crisp, shake tray after 10 minutes.
Cool on tray to crisp up more and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Oat Energy Balls
steps: Mix oats and coconut in bowl.
Add peanut butter and honey.
Stir well then use hands to mix to sticky dough.
Roll into 12 small balls.
Place on plate and chill in fridge for 10 minutes to firm.
Eat straight from fridge.

title: Coconut Oat Bites
steps: Mix oats and coconut in bowl.
Pour in condensed milk and stir until sticky.
Roll into small balls with wet hands.
Place on plate.
Chill in fridge for 10 minutes until firm.
Serve cold.

title: Chickpea Dip with Bread
steps: Drain chickpeas and rinse.
Add chickpeas, crushed garlic, lemon juice and oil to bowl.
Mash with fork or whisk until mostly smooth, add splash water if too thick.
Sprinkle paprika on top.
Toast bread until golden.
Cut toast into fingers and serve with dip.

title: Cream Cheese and Sweet Chilli Dip
steps: Let cream cheese soften at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Beat cream cheese with spoon until smooth.
Spread cream cheese into small bowl.
Spoon sweet chilli sauce over top and swirl lightly.
Warm tortillas in dry pan for 20 seconds per side and cut into triangles.
Serve tortillas with dip.

title: Avocado Dip with Toast
steps: Mash avocado flesh in bowl with fork.
Add crushed garlic, squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper.
Mix until mostly smooth.
Toast bread until golden.
Cut toast into soldiers or triangles.
Spoon dip into bowl and serve with toast.

title: No-Yeast Vetkoek
steps: Mix flour, baking powder and salt in bowl.
Pour in milk and mix to soft sticky dough, add extra flour if too wet.
Heat oil in pot on hot plate on medium heat.
Pinch off golf-ball pieces of dough with floured hands.
Fry vetkoek in hot oil 3 minutes per side until golden and puffed.
Drain on paper and serve warm with jam or polony if you have.

title: Cheese Straws
steps: Preheat oven to 200C and line tray with baking paper if you have.
Leave pastry on counter for 10 minutes to defrost slightly.
Beat egg in cup and brush over pastry sheet.
Grate cheese and sprinkle evenly over pastry.
Cut pastry into 2 cm strips with knife.
Twist each strip and place on tray.
Bake for 12 minutes until puffed and golden.

title: Sausage Rolls
steps: Preheat oven to 200C and line tray.
Leave pastry to defrost for 10 minutes.
Squeeze sausage meat out of skins into bowl.
Cut pastry sheet into two long rectangles.
Divide sausage meat along centre of each rectangle.
Beat egg and brush one edge, roll pastry over meat to seal.
Cut into 8 rolls, brush tops with egg and bake 20 minutes until golden.

title: Cheese and Ham Pinwheels
steps: Chop spring onions finely.
Spread cream cheese evenly over each tortilla.
Lay ham slices over cream cheese.
Sprinkle spring onions on top.
Roll each tortilla tightly.
Cut each roll into 4 pinwheels and serve.

title: Tuna and Sweetcorn Wrap
steps: Drain tuna and sweetcorn.
Mix tuna, sweetcorn and mayonnaise in bowl.
Warm tortillas in dry pan for 20 seconds per side.
Spoon tuna mix onto centre of each tortilla.
Roll up tightly tucking ends in.
Cut in half and serve.

title: Peanut Butter and Honey Sandwich
steps: Lay bread slices on board.
Spread peanut butter on one slice.
Drizzle honey over peanut butter.
Close sandwich with second slice.
Press lightly and cut in half to serve.

title: Jam Sandwich
steps: Spread margarine on both bread slices.
Spread jam on one slice.
Close sandwich.
Press lightly and cut into triangles.
Serve immediately.

title: Yeast Spread and Cheese Sandwich
steps: Spread margarine on both slices of bread.
Spread very thin layer of yeast spread on one slice.
Slice or grate cheese and lay on top.
Close sandwich and press lightly.
Cut in half and serve.

title: Cucumber and Cream Cheese Sandwiches
steps: Slice cucumber into thin rounds.
Spread cream cheese on each bread slice.
Arrange cucumber slices on 2 bread slices.
Sprinkle pinch of salt over cucumber.
Close with remaining bread slices.
Cut into fingers and serve.

title: Fried Potato Chips
steps: Peel potatoes and cut into thin chips.
Rinse chips in cold water and pat dry with clean cloth.
Heat oil in pot on hot plate on medium heat.
Fry chips in batches for 5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper.
Sprinkle salt and serve hot.

title: Mashed Potato Bites
steps: Peel potatoes, chop and boil until soft then drain and mash smooth.
Add salt and beaten egg to mash and mix.
Shape mash into small balls or patties with floured hands.
Roll each bite lightly in flour.
Heat oil in pan on medium heat.
Fry bites 3 minutes per side until golden and crisp, then serve.

title: Soya Chunk Bites
steps: Soak soya chunks in hot water from kettle for 5 minutes until soft.
Drain well and squeeze out water.
Toss chunks with flour, curry powder and salt to coat.
Heat oil in pan on hot plate on medium heat.
Fry bites for 4 minutes turning until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper and serve hot.

title: Yoghurt and Fruit Cup
steps: Spoon yoghurt into 2 cups or bowls.
Slice banana into rounds.
Top yoghurt with banana slices.
Drizzle honey over fruit.
Sprinkle oats on top for crunch and serve.

title: Frozen Yoghurt Banana Bites
steps: Slice bananas into 2 cm thick rounds.
Mix yoghurt and honey in bowl.
Dip each banana round into yoghurt to coat.
Sprinkle coconut over coated bites.
Place on tray lined with baking paper.
Freeze for 1 hour until firm and serve frozen.

title: Spiced Peanuts
steps: Heat oil in pan on hot plate on medium heat.
Add peanuts and fry for 4 minutes stirring often.
Sprinkle curry powder and salt over peanuts.
Toss for 1 minute until coated.
Remove from heat and cool slightly.
Serve in bowl.

title: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
steps: Preheat oven to 180C and line tray.
Rinse seeds and pat dry with clean cloth.
Toss seeds with oil and salt in bowl.
Spread in single layer on tray.
Roast for 12 minutes shaking tray halfway until golden and crisp.
Cool completely before eating.

title: Biltong Bites
steps: Slice biltong into thin bite-size pieces with sharp knife.
Arrange on plate or board.
Let come to room temperature for best flavour.
Serve as snack.

title: Cheese and Cucumber Crackers
steps: Slice cucumber into thin rounds.
Slice cheese into small squares.
Place cheese square on each cracker.
Top with cucumber round.
Arrange on plate and serve immediately.

title: Tinned Mackerel on Bread
steps: Chop onion finely.
Drain mackerel slightly and flake into bowl with some tomato sauce.
Mix onion into mackerel.
Toast bread until golden.
Spoon mackerel mix onto toast.
Serve immediately.

title: Toasted Cheese and Onion Sandwich
steps: Slice onion into thin rings.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place 2 slices butter side down on board.
Top with grated cheese and onion rings.
Close with remaining bread butter side up.
Fry in pan on medium heat 3 minutes per side until cheese melts and bread is golden.
